basics.name: Stanislav Natalenko
basics.label: CTO at BanQu Inc.
basics.summary: Engineering executive with 20+ years architecting distributed, event-sourced platforms from prototype to production scale. Currently CTO and Chief Architect at BanQu, leading the supply-chain transparency platform serving global enterprises. Inventor on three distributed-ledger patents and author of open-source toolkits for CQRS, Event Sourcing, and data transformation.

work.name: BanQu
work.description: Supply-chain transparency platform built on distributed-ledger technology, serving global enterprise customers
highlights: Lead a distributed team of senior engineers and QA specialists across multiple geographies, owning architecture, product direction, and delivery.
Built and operate the event-sourced platform powering 10M+ supply-chain events across global enterprise customers.
Named inventor on three distributed-ledger patents underpinning the BanQu system.

work.name: API Nation
work.description: Workflow automation and data-integration platform connecting business tools across the real estate industry.
highlights: Architected and built the integration platform's processing core on AWS Lambda and RabbitMQ with a set of orchestrator services, enabling massively parallel, on-demand processing of large data volumes.

work.name: SpiderSuite
work.description: Enterprise cloud and mobile inspection management platform for the commercial real estate industry, connecting banks, lenders, servicers, inspection companies, and field inspectors
highlights: Co-founded and grew the company from concept to a production platform serving the commercial real estate lending market.
Led end-to-end creation of an enterprise product, from initial concept and architecture through production launch.
Owned product UX, designing the majority of user-facing interfaces with a strong focus on usability and clarity.
Architected and implemented a scalable, message-driven platform following DDD, CQRS, and API-first principles.
Designed and built a responsive single-page web application with reliable offline and online operation.
Delivered a production-ready iOS application integrated with the core platform in under three months.
Established and enforced company-wide information security, disaster recovery, and business continuity standards.
Implemented high-availability infrastructure with multi-cloud failover across Azure and AWS.

work.name: SPS Commerce
work.description: Cloud-based supply-chain management software for retailers, suppliers, third-party logistics providers, and partners
highlights: Led development of the SPSC Universal Data Adapter, a turnkey integration product for exchanging data with a variety of ERP systems.

Facilitated the merge of Direct EDI and SPS Commerce engineering teams post-acquisition, transitioning SPSC product development to the Ukraine office and rolling out Agile Scrum across the merged team.

work.name: Direct EDI
work.description: E-commerce solutions for supply-chain network integration, ranging from web-based EDI to fully integrated enterprise systems. Acquired by SPS Commerce
highlights: Led or directly developed 5 of 7 core products, owning the full lifecycle from concept through launch and ongoing support.
Built, hired, and managed multiple cross-functional technology teams composed primarily of senior engineers, QA specialists, and UI designers.
Drove the transition from Waterfall to Agile Scrum across the entire technology organization.

work.name: Direct EDI
highlights: Planned, coordinated, and controlled delivery across stakeholders in the San Diego PMO, enterprise customers, and the Ukrainian development team.
